authority: The single reconciled count definition for the nominal ClimbPath 50 s baseline. The report, user manual and APP must cite these tiers instead of a bare 48-entry or single pass-count figure.
scope: Nominal ClimbPath 50 s, phase2_full_48 batch plus the 2026-07-31 pid_awff_linear_eso run. No multi-scenario, sensitivity, code-generation, Gazebo or deployment claim.
why_this_file_exists: Two parallel id namespaces exist. control_scheme_catalog.json is frozen at 2026-07-27 and owns terminology and family assignment. G3_STATUS.json was generated 2026-07-30 and owns execution status and performance. Both happen to hold 48 entries, but only 41 pairs align; the coincidence made a bare '48' ambiguous and a bare '29/48 pass' unverifiable.

tiers.definition: Approved top-level entries in the frozen design catalog: 47 MWORKS control profiles across seven families plus the px4ctrl engineering/deployment baseline.
tiers.not_usable_for: any execution or performance claim; 6 of these 48 have no FormalRunner at all

tiers.definition: FormalRunner .mo files that exist in the model tree, excluding package.mo.
tiers.not_usable_for: performance claim; existence of a runner does not imply it ran or passed

tiers.definition: Entries carrying evidence on both sides: 33 exact id matches plus 8 alias-resolved pairs.
tiers.usable_for: any statement that needs both an approved term and an execution record

tiers.definition: Runs that produced a complete readable 50 s dataset, regardless of tracking performance. G3 contributes 37; pid_awff_linear_eso contributes 1 (25001 samples, 2026-07-31, absent from the G3 batch).
tiers.not_usable_for: acceptance; 10 of these 38 exceed the terminal-error bound

tiers.definition: Ran to completion AND terminal position_error_norm below 5 m. This is the only tier that means accepted.

arithmetic_check.execution_universe_definition: 48 G3_STATUS rows plus the standalone pid_awff_linear_eso run, which is absent from the G3 batch. This equals formal_runner_files 49 and is deliberately NOT equal to catalog_frozen_entries 48.
arithmetic_check.do_not_expect: These tiers do not sum to 48. Any statement that mixes catalog_frozen_entries with execution tiers in one total is wrong.

ran_but_not_accepted.composition: 9 G3 rows with failure_class terminal_position_error_exceeds_5m, plus pid_awff_linear_eso from its standalone run
ran_but_not_accepted.definition: Complete 50 s dataset but terminal position_error_norm at or above 5 m. These are valid negative performance evidence, not failures to execute.

superseded_claims.29_of_48_pass: Not supported by any file. G3_STATUS.json reports effective_passed_count 28 and effective_failed_count 20. The 29/19 pair in the report body predates this reconciliation and must be replaced by the tier table above.
superseded_claims.48_entries_all_validated: Not supported. 48 is the frozen catalog size only; 6 of those entries have no FormalRunner and 11 runs never produced data.

open_items: control_scheme_catalog.json still marks pid_awff_linear_eso role=planned, implementation_status=planned, selection_eligibility=not_runnable although its runner, adapter and Sysblock all exist and a 50 s run completed. The entry is deliberately left unchanged because check_control_scheme_catalog.py enforces CSC-PLANNED-01 and CSC-COUNT-04 (exactly one planned profile) and CSC-FREEZE-01 pins frozen_at to 2026-07-27. Correcting it requires an explicit re-freeze decision plus matching validator constants.

Seven runners hold ClimbPath data but no approved catalog terminology: l_1, indi, improved_pid, fault_compensation, linear_mpc_rotor, official_pid_yaw_corrected, official_pid_yaw_authority_mapped. They must not be cited under a catalog family label until catalog entries exist.
G3_STATUS.json carries completed=false and generated_at 2026-07-30, so the G3 sweep itself is not closed.

model_studio_task_routes_v1.toml holds 48 [[route]] blocks of which 44 are available=true. Its pid_awff_linear_eso route is still available=false with reason 'no registered graphical control core, Adapter or FormalRunner', but PidAwffLinearEsoFormalRunner.mo now exists on disk and the controller completed a standalone 50 s run on 2026-07-31. The route table lags the model tree; available=false must not be read as unimplemented or never-run.

Five of the 49 FormalRunner files are absent from the 44 available Studio routes: FaultCompensationFormalRunner.mo, ImprovedPidFormalRunner.mo, OfficialPidYawAuthorityMappedFormalRunner.mo, OfficialPidYawCorrectedFormalRunner.mo, PidAwffLinearEsoFormalRunner.mo. The 49-vs-44 gap is a route-registration gap, not a performance result.
